content.json:
## Operator Nexus — Bare Metal Fleet Health

Rack-level readiness, machine state and maintenance audit trail for a Nexus instance.

Use the **Rack** filter to scope to a maintenance window. The *Maintenance readiness* tile is the GO/NO-GO gate: a rack must retain at least the configured number of healthy machines before another is taken down.

parameters.name: Rack
parameters.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceType == "BAREMETALMACHINES"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by tostring(Resource)
| distinct RackId = tostring(properties_rackId_s)
| order by RackId asc

parameters.name: MinHealthyPerRack
parameters.label: Healthy machines a rack must retain

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceType == "BAREMETALMACHINES"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by MachineName = tostring(Resource)
| extend RackId = tostring(properties_rackId_s)
| where '*' in ({Rack}) or RackId in ({Rack})
| extend Healthy = tostring(properties_readyState_s) == "True"
    and tostring(properties_powerState_s) == "On"
    and tostring(properties_cordonStatus_s) == "Uncordoned"
    and tostring(properties_detailedStatus_s) in ("Available", "Provisioned")
| summarize
    ['Total machines'] = count(),
    Healthy = countif(Healthy),
    Cordoned = countif(tostring(properties_cordonStatus_s) == "Cordoned"),
    ['Powered off'] = countif(tostring(properties_powerState_s) == "Off"),
    ['Not ready'] = countif(tostring(properties_readyState_s) != "True")

AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceType == "BAREMETALMACHINES"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by MachineName = tostring(Resource)
| extend RackId = tostring(properties_rackId_s)
| where '*' in ({Rack}) or RackId in ({Rack})
| extend Healthy = tostring(properties_readyState_s) == "True"
    and tostring(properties_powerState_s) == "On"
    and tostring(properties_cordonStatus_s) == "Uncordoned"
| summarize Total = count(), Healthy = countif(Healthy),
            Cordoned = countif(tostring(properties_cordonStatus_s) == "Cordoned"),
            ['Powered off'] = countif(tostring(properties_powerState_s) == "Off")
    by Rack = RackId
| extend Headroom = Healthy - toint('{MinHealthyPerRack}')
| extend Verdict = iff(Headroom > 0, "GO", "NO-GO")
| project Rack, Total, Healthy, Cordoned, ['Powered off'], Headroom, Verdict
| order by Rack asc

AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceType == "BAREMETALMACHINES"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by MachineName = tostring(Resource)
| extend RackId = tostring(properties_rackId_s), RackSlot = toint(properties_rackSlot_d)
| where '*' in ({Rack}) or RackId in ({Rack})
| project
    Machine = MachineName,
    Rack = RackId,
    Slot = RackSlot,
    Ready = tostring(properties_readyState_s),
    Power = tostring(properties_powerState_s),
    Cordon = tostring(properties_cordonStatus_s),
    Status = tostring(properties_detailedStatus_s),
    Message = tostring(properties_detailedStatusMessage_s),
    ['Kubernetes node'] = tostring(properties_kubernetesNodeName_s),
    ['Last seen'] = TimeGenerated
| where Ready != "True" or Power != "On" or Cordon != "Uncordoned" or Status !in ("Available", "Provisioned")
| order by Rack asc, Slot asc
content.noDataMessage: Every machine in scope is healthy.

content.json:
### Node ↔ bare metal correlation

A NotReady Kubernetes node is only actionable once the backing machine is identified.

content.query:
let bmm =
    AzureDiagnostics
    | where ResourceType == "BAREMETALMACHINES"
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by MachineName = tostring(Resource)
    | project MachineName,
              KubernetesNode = tostring(properties_kubernetesNodeName_s),
              RackId = tostring(properties_rackId_s),
              PowerState = tostring(properties_powerState_s),
              BmmReady = tostring(properties_readyState_s);
KubeNodeInventory
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer
| project KubernetesNode = Computer, NodeStatus = Status, LastSeen = TimeGenerated
| join kind=leftouter bmm on KubernetesNode
| where '*' in ({Rack}) or RackId in ({Rack})
| extend Diagnosis = case(
      NodeStatus != "Ready" and PowerState == "Off", "expected — BMM powered off",
      NodeStatus != "Ready" and BmmReady != "True",  "BMM also unhealthy — hardware first",
      NodeStatus != "Ready",                          "BMM healthy — investigate kubelet/CNI",
      "healthy")
| where NodeStatus != "Ready"
| project LastSeen, KubernetesNode, NodeStatus, Machine = MachineName, Rack = RackId, Power = PowerState, Diagnosis
| order by Rack asc

content.json:
### Power and cordon audit trail

Every lifecycle action taken against a bare metal machine, and who took it.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue has "MICROSOFT.NETWORKCLOUD/BAREMETALMACHINES"
| where OperationNameValue has_any ("POWEROFF", "START", "RESTART", "CORDON", "UNCORDON", "REPLACE")
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Machine = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[-1]),
    Operation = toupper(tostring(split(OperationNameValue, "/")[-2])),
    Status = ActivityStatusValue,
    Caller,
    CorrelationId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.noDataMessage: No bare metal lifecycle operations in this window.

content.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where Namespace == "container.azm.ms/disk" and Name == "used_percent"
| extend Device = tostring(todynamic(Tags)["device"]), MountPath = tostring(todynamic(Tags)["path"])
| summarize UsedPct = round(max(Val), 1) by Node = Computer, Device, MountPath
| where UsedPct >= 75
| extend Severity = case(UsedPct >= 90, "CRITICAL", UsedPct >= 80, "WARN", "INFO")
| order by UsedPct desc

InsightsMetrics
| where Namespace == "container.azm.ms/net"
| where Name in ("err_in", "err_out", "drop_in", "drop_out")
| extend Interface = tostring(todynamic(Tags)["interface"])
| summarize Total = sum(Val) by Node = Computer, Interface, Name
| summarize Errors = round(sumif(Total, Name startswith "err"), 0),
            Drops  = round(sumif(Total, Name startswith "drop"), 0)
    by Node, Interface
| where Errors > 0 or Drops > 1000
| order by Errors desc, Drops desc
content.noDataMessage: No interface errors or significant drops in this window.
